checks.detail: Preparation verifies committed baseline 4ff7bf45286a8a19d34401988adca587253ae41e / native0.66.0 / 329 files / ab674682f3345b09bec94959174fbb5bf0f1bd06154693697e5814987b572316 and candidate native0.67.0 / 331 files / c234bb404de43b380e5595cee8ad4ddfcae6e02d0fcc40286546fcf6838dd44a. Recursive proof fingerprints, real capture receipts, actual four forms, owner inventory, final graph review, reconciliation and separate functional review are bound.

The original forms are copied unchanged. preparedOnly=true, officialPerformanceEligible=false and strictCommonGraphParity=false are required, not relabeled. The new prospective cost contract separately admits four exact predeclared structural count paths with zero unattributed differences and no added programs.

Seven historical tool files are byte-identical in both checkouts and match the historical declaration. The ABBA measurement command and actual strict comparator remain unchanged. The JavaScript supplement imports guarded arithmetic exports only; the Python reviewer independently reconstructs arithmetic from raw reports.

A1/B1/B2/A2 each contain STCK10 and SMLP15, one 3-action warmup and four measured sessions per game: 40 total trials, 32 measured sessions/400 actions, 8 warmups/24 actions. Every trial must match its own final-source form, full work signature, version, pause positions and input identity. Slot identities and physical timestamp pairs must both be unique. No measured session or outlier may be omitted.

Eight complete session_elapsed durations per version/game are pooled before medians. JavaScript decimal-rational comparison and independent Python Decimal comparison require B median strictly below 1.1 times A separately for STCK and SMLP. There is no epsilon allowance, cross-game compensation or phase-based replacement of the global criterion. Phase overruns remain visible and may be accepted only when both globals pass.

The historical strict comparison is actually invoked after the completed window. Only exit 1 with no output and the specified work-metadata AssertionError is accepted as the retained refusal. Logs and before/after inputs are preserved. The supplement keeps historicalStrictComparisonPassed=false; an unexpected success or other failure is not relabeled.

The Python reviewer independently reproduces all 40 shapes/signatures, original pair diagnostics, pooled metrics, strict global decisions and structural differences. analysis_passed/review_passed describe validation, while globalBudgetAccepted remains separate. Neither reader grants isolation, official qualification or publication.

resolvedFindings.resolution: prepare.py now fingerprints the historical declaration before reading it and includes it in final input reverification.
Generated protocol now delegates exact cleanup and retention reserves to the prospective controller plan; no contradictory 30-second total remains.
Both analyze.mjs and review.py now require 40 unique (startedAt, finishedAt) pairs in addition to complete unique slot identities.

requiredAtExecution: Fresh final-source functional forms and successful independent functional review must exist and remain exact before contract preparation.
The declared official controller must actually complete and release its owned lock, with intact sources, logs and all four reports.
Retain the actual strict refusal, run both supplementary readers, and use globalBudgetAccepted for both games independently.
limitations: Static source review only; no cost, controller, comparator, native or functional execution was performed by this review.

The measured global is the historical controller session_elapsed scope, including pauses/resumes through the last acquired return; worker startup, begin, terminal inspection/close, browser rendering, network and live game engine cost are outside it.
New native sessions share a case worker within a series; this does not establish cold-process or cold-JIT timing.
Only the four exact declared structural count paths are admissible; this does not claim full strict historical work parity.
Official isolation and publication require separate actual evidence.
